short: Count identity for hosts with limited ramification

lean.name: Formalism.LFunctionChainParameters.characterSumData.AskMainBalance
lean.plain: Count identity for hosts with limited ramification
lean.note: This proposition expresses the deviation of a weighted prime-power count from its main term as a sum over characters, for hosts ramified at most at 2 and two odd primes. Lean proves this form in colour_balance, and the final theorem uses the version with a finite set of primes in place of 2 and the first odd prime.
